What's new in Snapwise 1.0.1

  • Choose what's in the menu bar menu: show, hide and reorder items in Settings › Menu.
  • Delayed capture now counts down before you pick an area or window, so open menus and hover states get captured.
  • Fixed the version number shown in About and used for updates.

What's new in Snapwise 1.0.0

  • Capture any area, window or the whole screen with a frozen-frame selector, magnifier and pixel-exact sizes.
  • Scrolling capture stitches long pages and chats into one image. Scroll yourself or let Snapwise auto-scroll.
  • Editor with arrows, shapes, text, numbered steps, highlighter, blur, pixelate, spotlight, crop, backdrops and zoom.
  • Copy text from anything on screen (OCR) and read QR codes, all on your Mac.
  • Pin screenshots above all windows, pick colors as HEX, RGB, HSL or OKLCH, and measure with the screen ruler.
  • Apple Intelligence: smart file names, one-click redaction of private info, and translation. Nothing leaves your Mac.
  • Opens at login and keeps itself up to date.
